headline: Last session: Sensex drops 319 points, Nifty ends at 25,144 as inflation concerns weigh on markets

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns and rising crude oil pressures weighed on market sentiment during the last trading session.
Benchmark indices snapped their recent winning streak as market participants turned cautious.
Chief Economic Advisor V Anantha Nageswaran noted that rate hikes may not tame supply-led inflation.
Key financial stocks faced selling pressure, dragging the indices lower.
whatHappening: In the last session, Sensex fell 319 points and Nifty 50 closed at 25,144.
Shriram Finance emerged as the top loser in the previous trading session.
Manappuram Finance shares declined 4% during Friday's trading session.
Despite Friday's decline, Indian markets extended gains for the third consecutive week.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices snapped their winning streak, with the Sensex falling over 300 points and Nifty closing at 25,144. Market sentiment was weighed down by inflation concerns and crude oil price pressures. Indian markets remain closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 16 November.
